newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish insurer Salus buys rival Ansvar.
newsitem.headline: Swedish insurer Salus buys rival Ansvar.

text.p: Swedish insurer Salus said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to buy rival Ansvar.
The deal is one of the first moves in the Swedish insurance sector which analysts expect to be heading for restructuring.

An acquisition would give Salus another 200,000 customers in Sweden, additional premium income of about 1.4 billion crowns and around three billion crowns more of assets, the company said in a statement.
Salus did not disclose the acquisition price but said the deal would have a negative impact on earnings per share in Salus Holding in 1997 and a positive effect as of 1998.
Salus added it expected to sign the final contract in June.
